scope.summary: Replace handwritten globalMap/TTL in useV5Live.ts and Operations.tsx with scoped TanStack Query v5 client, thread AbortSignal from TanStack Query context through loaders and underlying BFF transport (bffFetch/strictLiveRead), implement user-authorized double-audit F12/S05 exact regression test for caller migration, identity/environment switch, same-key and cross-scope stale in-flight response discard, AbortSignal cancellation, and logout cache isolation, and close remaining production fixture plumbing.

retired_caches.replacement: TanStack Query v5 useQuery + queryKeys.resource() scoped by tenantId, userId, baseUrl, mode
TanStack Query v5 queryClient + queryKeys.operations.list() scoped by tenantId, userId, baseUrl, mode

key_design_principles: Query keys are scoped by active tenantId, userId, baseUrl, and mode via getActiveQueryScope().
Authentication tokens, JWTs, and bearer tokens are strictly forbidden from being used as query keys.
Logout, user changes, and environment changes invoke clearScopedQueries() which cancels in-flight queries and clears all cached reads.
AbortSignal is threaded through TanStack Query queryFn context into loaders and BFF transport (strictLiveRead / bffFetch), supporting automatic unmount cancellation and manual query cancellation.
Same-key stale response races are prevented by TanStack Query query cancellation on refresh and supersede.
Existing SSE event invalidation, confirmed-command invalidation semantics, and live degraded presentation are fully preserved.
Zero reachable mock/seed/overlay modules in production bundle graph verified via check_bundle_mock_reachability.ts.

modified_files.description: Centralized TanStack Query v5 query keys factory, active query scope resolver (tenantId, userId, baseUrl, mode), shared QueryClient accessor, and clearScopedQueries() invalidator/canceller.
Added optional getUserId accessor to AuthProvider interface, getter/setter, and clearAuthProvider() for clean test resets.
Registered getUserId accessor in registerBffBrowserSession() so QueryScope reliably captures current authenticated user ID without token leakage.
Integrated clearScopedQueries() on user change (!sameUser), devLogin(), and signOut() to cancel in-flight queries and purge cached reads.
Replaced handwritten v5LiveCache Map with TanStack Query v5 useQuery; forward QueryFunctionContext.signal to loader and cancel in-flight query on refresh.
Replaced handwritten operationListCache Map with TanStack Query v5 queryClient; forward signal to loader and cancel in-flight query on force reload.

Added optional opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal } to cockpit, humanInbox, tradingPulse, personaFleet, evidence, personaIntent, portfolioBook, personaLeague, quarterlyRanking, performanceAttribution, and operationsReadModel live read methods.
Added optional opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal } to loops, personas, strategies, sentinel, and interventions methods.

Added optional opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal } to readRecords, dataSources, permissions, memoryGovernance, consultRules, lineage, workflowTemplates, hookRegistry, knowledgeInbox, and oodaPacketDetail.

User-authorized double-audit F12/S05 exact regression test suite covering Operations caller migration (Jobs, Alerts, Incidents, Approvals, Audit), identity switch isolation, environment switch isolation, cross-scope and same-key stale in-flight response discard, AbortSignal cancellation, and logout cache isolation.
Extended unit tests for useV5Live validating query execution, concurrent deduplication, scope isolation, AbortSignal unmount abort, and same-key race cancellation.
Verified AuthProvider signs out, switches users, and clears scoped queries correctly.
Verified registerBffBrowserSession correctly populates getUserId.
